subject: Approval request: runtime/platform hiring slate + pay-band alignment (Q2)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruiting <recruiting@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: runtime/platform hiring slate + pay-band alignment (Q2)

Hi all,

Following up from last week's planning sync — attached is a compact hiring slate for the runtime/platform team that requests approval to open 3 positions this quarter:

- Staff SWE, Runtime (2 reqs) — focus on KV-cache+batching optimizations
- Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Platform (1 req) — lead autoscaling/capacity features

Why now: the product road map has two high-impact launches in H2 that require lowered p99 latency and more predictable throughput. We need to start interviews in April to hit H2 milestones.

Key asks:
1) Headcount approval to open the 3 reqs (we're requesting conversion of one unfilled headcount from Q1, plus two new slots).
2) Sign-off on the proposed comp bands & offer strategy attached (comp_bands_runtime_q2.xlsx). For market context, I worked with Recruiting and Compensation on ranges and the proposal includes a reduced signing bonus + slightly higher equity to keep FY24 OTE within our planned spend.

Important constraints: 
- We have one near-term candidate (Devin Carter) who is expecting an offer by early April — request guidance on target level and OTE.
- Finance flagged the Q2 hiring headroom as tight; I've included cost-neutral alternatives in the sheet (shift signing bonus into equity vests).

Attachments: comp_bands_runtime_q2.xlsx; offer_packet_template_v3.pdf

Please reply with approve / approve with modifications / hold by EOD Wednesday so Recruiting can schedule panels.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Recruiting <recruiting@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: runtime/platform hiring slate + pay-band alignment (Q2)

Thanks Olga — I reviewed the slate and the comp bands quickly. A couple of notes: 

- I support both Staff SWE reqs given the roadmap risk; the SRE req is borderline but OK if we can show capacity offsets.
- For Devin Carter (external candidate): resume looks strong; hiring manager suggests Staff vs Senior distinction depends on system design depth. Recommend we target Staff SWE (L6-equivalent) with a firm OTE target in the comp sheet.

Questions for Markus/Finance:
- Can we confirm that the proposed equity-heavy structure won't push us over the FY24 comp plan? Sheet shows a slightly higher 4-yr eq grant for Staff but a lower signing bonus.
- If Finance can't commit, can we temporarily approve headcount but cap offers to the mid-band while Recruiting continues the search?

I left inline comments in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-runtime-hiring-slate

On the quick-approval timeline: if we get thumbs-up by Wed EOD, Recruiting can send a preliminary leveling and comp call to Devin and keep momentum.

Jonas
VP, Platform & Runtime

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Recruiting <recruiting@redwood.com>, Finance <finance@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: runtime/platform hiring slate + pay-band alignment (Q2)

Appreciate the context. Quick finance readout: 

- FY24 hiring envelope has ~3.2M of remaining approved headcount spend across engineering. Approving these 3 reqs as proposed would use ~420k of that envelope (fully-loaded comp and benefits for FY24 pro-rated).
- The equity lift in the comp sheet is the primary driver of the bump; if we move the signing bonus into the equity bucket (front-loaded 1st-year cliffed RSUs) we can keep FY24 cash spend lower and stay within plan. That aligns with what Olga proposed.

Operational ask: please mark the roles as provisional approvals — open the reqs in Greenhouse with a hiring freeze tag "prov-approve-Q2" so Recruiting can start outreach and interview scheduling. Final firm offers should be escalated to Finance + People for any OTE above top of band.

On Devin Carter specifically: if we believe Devin is a Staff hire, cap the initial offer at the mid-to-high band with equity adjusted as discussed. If the candidate pushes for above-band cash, escalate.

I'm fine to sign off on the provisional headcount and the comp-band approach as long as Recruiting follows the escalation path.

-Markus
CFO (acting)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruiting <recruiting@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: runtime/platform hiring slate + pay-band alignment (Q2)

Thanks everyone — approve provisional opening of the 3 roles and the comp-band approach with the conditions Markus noted. Two quick operational asks before Recruiting sends anything official: 

1) Olga/Recruiting: include a short paragraph in the candidate outreach that explains the equity-forward offer structure and typical vesting cadence (4yr, 1yr cliff). That helps set expectations and reduces negotiation cycles.
2) Recruiting: route any cash-above-band requests to me + Markus for rapid decisioning and document escalations in GH ticket GH-78321.

Jonas/Olga, proceed with provisional postings and coordinator scheduling. Recruiting — coordinate a quick leveling call with Devin this week and keep the offer window tight (7 days) if we decide to move forward.

Lauren
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
